Hello,

I saw your opening for the Jr. Graphics and UI/UX Designer role in Andheri West and noticed the focus on system design and visual consistency.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time across over one hundred creatives. Before that, at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated findings directly into user flows and wireframes.

You can see this structured problem-solving in Bounceless, my B2B UX case study demonstrating a cleaner verification experience at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and am ready to relocate to Mumbai for this onsite role. Could I send over my resume or walk you through one case study in a brief call?

Ananya
